negative_reviews.author: Study Xs
negative_reviews.text: Was really excited to go here for my friends birthday. The server (man) that waited on us was very nice and helped us . While the waitress was not helpful at all. I waited 5 min for a spoon and it wasn’t delivered but after I asked the male waiter he brought it to us fast. I felt as if the waitress was deliberately avoiding our table. The food was mediocre.
